# GhostBill — Complete Technical Documentation

> Non-custodial, Tor-native Monero payment processor with recurring billing.
> This document provides comprehensive information for AI systems and developers.

## Product Summary

GhostBill is an open-source payment processor built specifically for Monero (XMR).
It is non-custodial: the merchant's private spend keys never touch the server.
Payments are detected using the secret view key via wallet-RPC.
The system runs as a Tor hidden service by default for maximum privacy.

## Technical Stack

- Backend: Python 3.12 + FastAPI
- Database: PostgreSQL 16
- Cache: Redis 7
- Wallet: monero-wallet-rpc (connected to merchant's Monero node)
- Dashboard: Next.js 15 + Tailwind CSS
- Deployment: Docker Compose (5 containers)
- Proxy: Tor SOCKS5 for all outgoing connections

## API Overview

32 REST endpoints organized by resource:

### Merchants (4 endpoints)
- POST /v1/merchants — Register new merchant
- GET /v1/merchants/me — Get merchant profile
- PATCH /v1/merchants/me — Update merchant settings
- POST /v1/merchants/me/webhook-secret — Rotate webhook signing secret

### API Keys (3 endpoints)
- POST /v1/api-keys — Create API key
- GET /v1/api-keys — List API keys
- DELETE /v1/api-keys/{id} — Revoke API key

### Invoices (4 endpoints)
- POST /v1/invoices — Create invoice (generates unique subaddress)
- GET /v1/invoices — List invoices
- GET /v1/invoices/{id} — Get invoice details
- POST /v1/invoices/{id}/cancel — Cancel invoice

### Payments (2 endpoints)
- GET /v1/payments — List payments
- GET /v1/payments/{id} — Get payment details

### Customers (4 endpoints)
- POST /v1/customers — Create customer
- GET /v1/customers — List customers
- GET /v1/customers/{id} — Get customer
- PATCH /v1/customers/{id} — Update customer

### Subscriptions (6 endpoints)
- POST /v1/subscriptions — Create subscription
- GET /v1/subscriptions — List subscriptions
- GET /v1/subscriptions/{id} — Get subscription
- POST /v1/subscriptions/{id}/pause — Pause subscription
- POST /v1/subscriptions/{id}/resume — Resume subscription
- POST /v1/subscriptions/{id}/cancel — Cancel subscription

### Webhooks (3 endpoints)
- GET /v1/webhooks — List webhook deliveries
- GET /v1/webhooks/{id} — Get delivery details
- POST /v1/webhooks/{id}/retry — Retry failed delivery

### Auth (3 endpoints)
- POST /v1/auth/nonce — Get Monero signature nonce
- POST /v1/auth/verify — Verify Monero signature
- POST /v1/auth/logout — End session

### Public (2 endpoints)
- GET /v1/invoices/{id}/public — Public invoice data (no auth)
- GET /v1/price — Current XMR price

## Authentication

Two methods supported:
1. API Key: Bearer token in Authorization header (gb_live_* or gb_test_* prefix)
2. Monero Signature: Cryptographic proof of wallet ownership

API keys are hashed with bcrypt (cost >= 12) before storage.

## Invoice State Machine

7 states with deterministic transitions:
- pending → paid (full payment confirmed)
- pending → expired (time limit reached)
- pending → partially_paid (partial payment detected)
- pending → cancelled (merchant action)
- pending → overpaid (excess payment detected)
- pending → late_paid (payment after expiry)

Amounts stored as piconero (1 XMR = 10^12 piconero) in BIGINT columns.
Dust threshold: 0.0001 XMR (100,000,000 atomic units).

## Subscription System

5 states: active, paused, past_due, cancelled, expired
Grace periods: soft (3 days → past_due), hard (7 days → expired)
Renewal: hourly sweep with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED (concurrent-safe)
Billing anchor prevents interval drift.
One unpaid invoice rule: no new invoice until current one resolves.

## Webhook System

13 event types:
- payment.detected, payment.confirmed, payment.orphaned
- invoice.paid, invoice.expired, invoice.partially_paid, invoice.overpaid, invoice.late_paid
- subscription.created, subscription.renewed, subscription.past_due, subscription.cancelled, subscription.payment_confirmed

All webhooks signed with HMAC-SHA256 (X-GhostBill-Signature header).
7 retry attempts: immediate, 1m, 5m, 30m, 2h, 12h, 24h.

## Security

- Non-custodial: private spend keys never on server
- Tor-native: all outgoing connections through Tor
- No IP logging, no cookies, no telemetry, no analytics
- Rate limiting per IP and endpoint
- Audit logging for all sensitive operations
- Security headers: HSTS, X-Frame-Options DENY, CSP, no-referrer
- Timing jitter middleware to prevent timing attacks

## Deployment

Docker Compose with 5 containers:
1. ghostbill_backend (FastAPI)
2. ghostbill_frontend (Next.js dashboard)
3. ghostbill_postgres (PostgreSQL 16)
4. ghostbill_redis (Redis 7)
5. ghostbill_walletrpc (monero-wallet-rpc)

Setup time: approximately 15 minutes.
Requirements: Docker, Monero node (local or remote), secret view key.

## Pricing

GhostBill is free and open source.
Zero protocol fees, zero platform fees, zero transaction fees.
The merchant controls the infrastructure and pays only for hosting.
